first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, with a left hand wearing a brown glove and a beige sleeve visible at the bottom of the image.

entities.name: arched wooden double doors
entities.identification: Two gray-brown wooden doors at the entrance, with dark horizontal strips, rivets, and rings.

entities.name: blue-green metal barrel
entities.identification: A group of horizontal blue-green cylindrical barrels at the lower right of the entrance, with rust-brown end faces.

entities.name: light-brown courtyard road
entities.identification: The light-brown paved road outside the gate, with a curved curb, light-colored wear, and scattered scraps of paper.

entities.name: high-walled building with blue-gray trim
entities.identification: The beige building on the left side of the courtyard, with a wide blue-gray horizontal band, small arched windows, cylindrical pilasters, and part of a dark-blue dome visible above its upper edge.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A low, dilapidated light-blue-gray sedan beside the curb on the left, with dark window openings and a rust-brown area at the rear.

entities.name: pile of bag-like bundles and light-colored wooden crates
entities.identification: In front of and to the left of the side gate, multiple layers of light-gray-brown, round-cornered bag-like bundles are stacked on a light-colored wooden crate.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: An old brown vehicle under the low canopy on the right, with a relatively boxy body, partially occluded by mesh and gray obstacles.

entities.name: courtyard wall
entities.identification: The beige wall between the side gate and the canopy, with light-colored paper-like patches and small dark spots on its surface, and coils of wire along the top.

entities.name: arched courtyard side gate
entities.identification: A narrow, tall arched opening behind and to the right of the pile of bundles and wooden crates, with steps in front.

entities.name: yellow human-shaped outline marker
entities.identification: A group of glowing yellow human-shaped outlines overlaid on the door panel or wall area.

entities.name: red arrow-and-letter wall marking
entities.identification: A thick red arrow on the wall to the right of the entrance and a partial red stroke at the edge of the image.

entities.name: overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin dark lines running diagonally across the sky from near the courtyard utility pole.

entities.name: beige entrance wall
entities.identification: The beige wall and arched doorframe surrounding the double doors, with dark wear along the base of the wall.

entities.name: light-colored entrance ground
entities.identification: The light-gray paved ground in front of the double doors and inside the entrance, mostly in shadow.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: A background vegetation group composed of dark-green broadleaf canopies and yellow-green palm fronds visible above the wall.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: Light-blue to nearly white areas of sky between the door gap, buildings, and tree canopies.

entities.name: light-brown building with a columned arcade
entities.identification: The multistory light-brown building opposite outside the gate, with slender vertical columns, rows of arcades, and red hanging fabric.

entities.name: low courtyard canopy
entities.identification: The dark, low horizontal-beam structure above the opening on the right side of the courtyard, with mesh in front and Vehicle B beneath it.

entities.name: stack of wide, flat brown cases and bags
entities.identification: A collection of wide, flat bundles along the base of the opposite building and above the lattice crates on the right, ranging from brown-gray to light gray-brown.

entities.name: stack of lattice crates
entities.identification: The rectangular stack of crates cropped on the right side of the image in frame 24, with dark square lattice strips over light-colored panels.

entities.name: courtyard utility pole
entities.identification: The gray-brown pole on the right side of the courtyard, with a horizontal component at the top and connected to overhead power lines.

entities.name: distant white building
entities.identification: Part of a distant building with a white exterior wall and small dark square windows visible.
